about: Single-slot corrections on top of the refined release (refined-original-release.json). scripts/patch-refined-slots.py writes them into the sources folder; scripts/build-mascot-packs.py refuses a folder where a patched sheet is still the release's. The cell PNGs live with the sources, outside git.

patches.source: AMR_Flashlight_Corrected_API.zip of 17 November 2026 (closed-grip revision, gpt-image-2.5 through the API): AMR_Flashlight_Corrected_384x512.png
patches.why: The release drew his lowered left hand as a small claw, and the torch threw no light. The revision redraws the whole frame from the approved standing master: a natural left hand with the watch on that wrist, the torch held in a closed grip in his right, and a warm beam from its lens.
patches.head_scale_why: The redrawn head came out about 16% under the live idle's and its scene neighbours' (width 0.79, height 0.84), so it shrank for 1.1 s between lights.torch and lights.ok. x1.10 brings it to width 0.88, height 0.92, inside the 15% rule; three judges passed it with no seam at the collar, lanyard or hairline (x1.18 overshot the neighbours).
